title: Anime home measured against the performance budgets
done_when: perf/harness.mjs adapted to /; Chromium at 1440x900 and 390x844, with and without 4x CPU throttle, refresh floor read first; every budget in CLAUDE.md met or the trade-off presented
evidence: Measured 2026-10-01 on the VPS (chromium headless, software raster, no GPU), four configurations plus one control, all ten scroll assertions passing in each: perf-results/2026-10-01T18-24-03-826Z-anime-desktop-3.json (1440x900 cpu x1), -anime-desktop-x4.json (1440x900 cpu x4), -anime-mobile-x1.json (390x844 cpu x1), -anime-mobile-x4.json (390x844 cpu x4), -anime-desktop-nowheel.json (control, wheel stubbed). Budgets are NOT met and the trade-off is presented instead: idle-top runs 33.2-33.3 ms median at 1440x900 against a 16.7 ms budget, p95 50 ms and three frames over 50 ms at cpu x4, and the rocket phases sit at p95 33.3-33.4 against a 25 ms budget. The stubbed control returns idle-top to 16.7 ms, so the hero wheel is the cause at desktop width; at 390x844 it costs nothing measurable. Heap flat (2.0 -> 2.1 MB over three cycles), nodes 931 -> 931, listeners flat, no forced reflows, no console errors. Renderer RSS was not measured: perf/rss.mjs matches macOS process names. What to do about the wheel is F10, the owner's decision, and a GPU may absorb the cost entirely, so his Mac and iPhone come first.
